success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant reschedules the recurring house cleaning from the original Friday morning slot to a new date that fits the user's teaching schedule and confirms the updated appointment details, including time window and any fee changes.

task.objective: Reschedule my house cleaning service appointment

cancellation_policy.refund_policy: Full refund if cancelled 24+ hours before service; 50% refund if cancelled within 24 hours.

persona.name: Dr. Melissa K. Andrade
persona.occupation: Assistant Professor of Public Health Nutrition
persona.bio: Melissa Andrade is a public health nutrition researcher at the University of Oregon who studies how water consumption shapes preschoolers’ food choices, especially in childcare and Head Start settings. She spends a lot of time in classrooms observing snack time, talking with teachers and parents, and translating her findings into simple, practical recommendations. Outside of work, she’s an avid runner and home cook who loves testing kid-friendly recipes on her own two children.
persona.writing_style: warm, professional-academic, clear and organized, occasional parenthetical asides, friendly but precise
sample_messages: Hi there, could you send over the final snack-time observation sheets from the Friendly Frog Preschool site? I want to double-check our coding for the water vs. juice exposure before I lock the analysis file.

This looks great overall. My only suggestion is to soften the language in the discussion where we talk about causality—maybe rephrase to emphasize "association" and note the limitations of self-reported intake.
Quick question: are you okay if we include the photo of the classroom water station (with all faces blurred, of course) in the conference poster, or would you prefer we stick to graphics only?
